slides.subtitle: Open-Source AI Tools for Security, Audit, and DevOps | August 18, 2026 at 5:00 AM PDT

slides.title: What this covers
slides.body: How to use open-source AI tools around security, audit, and DevOps workflows.

slides.title: Why it matters
slides.body: AI-assisted projects still need security scanning, audit trails, incident investigation, and deployment discipline.

slides.title: Main workflow
slides.body: Use AI around pull request audit and review. Connect security scanning to AI-assisted workflows.

slides.title: What you will leave with
slides.body: Keep humans, policy, and audit trails in the loop.
